sanskrit: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते । तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥
hindiTranslation: इस मनुष्यलोकमें ज्ञानके समान पवित्र करनेवाला निःसन्देह दूसरा कोई साधन नहीं है ।  जिसका योग भलीभाँति सिद्ध हो गया है, वह कर्मयोगी उस तत्त्वज्ञानको अवश्य ही स्वयं अपनेआपमें पा लेता है ॥
englishTranslation: No purifier compares to knowledge in this world. The one perfected in yoga finds that knowledge within the self in time.
essence: Nothing purifies like knowledge, and yoga ripens it from within.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Clear understanding is the highest purifier. A person who has matured through yoga eventually discovers that truth within themselves.
simpleInsight: Steady practice brings understanding from within, given time.
detailedMeaning: Krishna keeps turning action into understanding for Arjuna, who is still frozen. After saying knowledge burns karma, Krishna adds that no purifier equals knowledge, and that a person perfected through yoga will eventually realize it within.
modernRelevance: Years into learning classical music, a singer finds one day that the raga comes from inside her without effort. Krishna says knowledge arrives like that for someone matured in yoga: in time, and from within.
translationLiteral: न (not) / हि (indeed) / ज्ञानेन (by knowledge) / सदृशं (equal) / पवित्रम्इह (purifying here) / विद्यते (exists) / तत् (that) / स्वयम् (by oneself) / योगसंसिद्धः (one perfected in yoga) / कालेन (in time) / आत्मनि (in the self) / विन्दति (finds)
insight: Nothing purifies like knowledge, Krishna says, and a person ripened in yoga finds it within, in time.

quoteVariants.text: Knowledge purifies more than anything else. The perfected one finds it within.
Knowledge purifies all. Find it within.
Let knowledge purify you from within.
